refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the number of elements in the cache

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public intCachingIterator::count
Returns the number of elements in the cache. This is the number of elements iterated over so far, not the number of elements of the inner iterator. Elements are stored in the cache by key, so an element replaces any earlier element with the same key.
The CachingIterator::FULL_CACHE flag must be set.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the number of elements in the cache.
